notes.title: MY HOUSE UPDATE 1
notes.content:
Hello, dear gamers and visitors!

Here's a breakdown of the first major update for "MY HOUSE":

GRAPHICS

* The entire plant life system has been completely redesigned, making all trees, bushes, flowers, and grass dynamic.
* All tree models have been reworked, and most textures replaced. Each object now utilizes its own unique material.
* Significant model optimization has been implemented. Additionally, we've introduced multiple color variations for foliage and randomized model appearances.
* All rock models have been replaced.

SOUND EFFECTS

*A humorous voice-over has been added, which greets the player character and jokingly threatens to destroy their house. Six randomized variations of this greeting play at the start of each level.
* A unique voice-over now mocks the player upon losing in a comedic fashion.
* A distinct sound effect has been implemented for when the player attempts to fire with an empty rifle magazine.

GAME LOGIC

* Reloading is now restricted to situations where the magazine contains fewer than 12 bullets.
* The player's house is now destroyed when its health reaches zero, resulting in its removal from the game.
* Any remaining monsters are also removed from the game upon the player's house being destroyed.

VISUAL EFFECTS

* Four types of butterflies have been added to daytime locations. Dandelion seeds now float in the air in specific areas.
* Fireflies of four different colors have been introduced to nighttime locations.
* Monster spawn portals have been added to all locations.
* Two new locations, "Waterfalls" and "Fantasy Town," have been added.

I hope you enjoy the new content!
